rules.title: Purchase of IT Equipment
rules.content: All purchases of IT equipment must include: (1) Detailed technical specifications, (2) Vendor quotation, (3) Justification for selection, (4) Total cost breakdown.

rules.title: Annual Maintenance Contracts
rules.content: Annual maintenance contracts must specify: (1) Scope of services, (2) Response time SLA, (3) Penalty clauses for downtime, (4) Cost with tax details.
